title: Feature Request:  Exercise button.
body: I'm happily using the "boost" version at present but have a request that I feel could benefit everyone.  When I am going to do exercise I prepare in advance by setting a %age profile, raising target and turning off SMB with high temp target and SMB always.  I find that when I finish I remember to change profile and target back, but would also like to turn SMB always and SMB with high temp target back on - at times sensitivity raises my target and if I forget to turn SMB with high temp target back on I don't get any.  It would be nice to have a single "exercise soon" button somewhere that I could press and have all the above done, and either by setting a length of time or unclicking the button.  No big issue, just convenience really!

comments.body: Forget this, not necessary.  I now realise that sensitivity does not set a temp target, only raises target, so I can disable smb with high temp target at all times.
